#include <iostream>
#include <vector>

using namespace std;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;

    vector<vector<long long>> dp(2 * n + 1, vector<long long>(2 * n + 1, 0));
    dp[1][1] = 1;

    for (int i = 2; i <= 2 * n; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (j > 0) {
                dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j - 1];
                if (dp[i][j] >= MOD) dp[i][j] -= MOD;
            }
            if (j < 2 * n) {
                dp[i][j] += dp[i - 1][j + 1];
                if (dp[i][j] >= MOD) dp[i][j] -= MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    long long ans = 0;
    for (int i = 2 * n - 1; i >= 0; i -= 2) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= i; j++) {
            if (2 * n - i >= j) {
                ans += dp[i][j];
                if (ans >= MOD) ans -= MOD;
            }
        }
    }

    cout << ans << endl;
    return 0;
}
